briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 escalate multi-agent capabilities amid rising safety concerns

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI frontier remains intensely competitive with rapid model releases from major labs. Funding continues at record pace while prompt injection vulnerabilities persist across deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced multi-agent orchestration. Anthropic's Claude 4 and Meta's Llama 4.1 push context windows beyond 2M tokens. DeepSeek-V3 matches GPT-4o performance at lower cost.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 500k units monthly. Microsoft and xAI announce joint 200k H100 cluster in Texas. TSMC reports AI chip demand up 68% YoY.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-source models close the gap to frontier labs by end of 2027?
